answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs: (1) one helper, _repo_of(census_root: Path) -> Path, returning census_root.parent if census_root.name == 'cairn' else census_root; (2) encapsulation_holds (:4768-4771) and no_iou_stands (:5176-5179) keep their loop that walks comp_dir up to the census root and replace `repo_root = str(root.parent)` with `repo_root = str(_repo_of(root))`; (3) :4196 uses the helper as well, so there is one spelling; (4) clause 1's tooth records the argument by wrapping inspector.import_sieve.import_sites in place (restored in finally), and clears inspector._BREACH_CACHE and _CENSUS_DIRS before each call; (5) fixtures come from scratch_dir (cairn/tools/base/scratch), as test_encapsulation_holds.py:96 does; the git repo in clause 2 is `git init` with GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, plus one committed file holding an IOU line; (6) a row is {'dir': <name>, 'component': <name>} and comp_dir = census_root/<name>, as test_no_iou_stands.py:67 builds it.
